caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of black and gray on a beige background and depicts a mortar and pestle set comprised of a long, elliptical bowl with pointed ends and four short, outward-angled legs. The pestle has a thick, elongated cylindrical handle attached to a disk-shaped grinding base with concentric circular ridges. The main image is a perspective drawing of the set, with the pestle positioned upright within the bowl. Surrounding the central image, there are four smaller technical sketches: a top view of the bowl and pestle, a side view of the bowl, a front elevation of the bowl on its legs, and a top-down view of the disk portion of the pestle placed within the bowl. A scale in inches is included in the bottom left corner, and the name "H. BADER" is written in capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Coffee Grinder
